verdict.rationale: Namecheap is a domain registrar and DNS service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence shows only an XML API, a Terraform provider and a Go SDK, which are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server. Nothing in the pack mentions an official MCP server or endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
